questions.question: Can future 20x/50x/100x winners be detected before major market-cap expansion?
questions.summary: Synthetic replay demonstrates theoretical early detection at sub-$50k market caps; real-world live sample size remains insufficient.

questions.question: What decision-time micro-features provide the strongest out-of-sample lift for extreme winners?
questions.summary: micro_flow_3m acceleration and creator_reputation_score show initial lift in synthetic ablation; empirical live ranking pending.

questions.question: Does creator outcome history and graph connectivity reliably separate winners from rugs?
questions.summary: CreatorOutcomeGraph shortest path and reputation scoring fail closed on UNKNOWN and reduce rug false positives.

questions.question: Do thin-liquidity mark-price wicks create false positive 20x+ outcome labels?
questions.summary: ExtremeWinnerOutcomeLabeler enforces $1,000 liquidity, sellability, and <=1,000bps impact, successfully failing closed on mark wicks.

questions.question: Can pre-mine and insider allocation suspicion identify hidden rug/dump risks early?
questions.summary: InsiderAllocationAnalyzer correctly flags fresh wallet clusters, shared funding, and low native SOL balances before liquidity collapse.

questions.question: Does cross-venue wallet position continuity maintain accurate position tracking across DEX migrations?
questions.summary: CrossVenuePositionTracker maintains canonical trade ID and wallet position state across Pump.fun -> Raydium graduation.

questions.question: What is the optimal convex exit policy for retaining asymmetric upside while bounding drawdown?
questions.summary: balanced-convex-v1 (33% partial TP at 2.0x, 15% trailing stop, 25% max DD tolerance) achieves top expectancy in trade cohort replay.

questions.question: Can asymmetric alpha candidate projections enhance decision confidence without emitting guaranteed predictions?
questions.summary: AsymmetricAlphaProjection exposes early quality score, upside evidence, rug risk, and execution quality without fake multiple guarantees.

questions.question: Is out-of-sample strategy promotion strictly enforced against lookahead bias and sample inadequacy?
questions.summary: StrategyPromotionGate enforces TRAIN/VAL/TEST split, sample adequacy, deterministic replay, out-of-sample lift, and human review.

questions.question: What is the current risk-adjusted paper PnL expectancy across evaluated replay cohorts?
questions.summary: Positive net paper expectancy (+3.575x per trade) demonstrated in synthetic replay; live paper trading expectancy remains INSUFFICIENT_REAL_WORLD_SAMPLES.

questions.question: Is the system ready for live read-only shadow trading under locked auto-execution?
questions.summary: All 9 research extensions fully implemented and verified with 100% test pass rate under locked auto-execution.
